title: _Per deam Partulam et Pertundam nunc est bibendum_!
html_source: This is Latin for “By the goddesses Partula (goddess of childbirth) and Pertunda (goddess presiding over loss of virginity) now it is time to drink!” This also ends the section in the style of Carlyle, which began above with “Burke’s!”
